hero.badge: AI governance for firms and in-house teams
hero.welcome: Welcome to a new generation of privacy and AI governance software.
hero.subtitle: Open framework for AI governance. Registry, risk classification, assessments, human oversight and incident management, mapped across nine frameworks: the EU AI Act, the GDPR, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, AIUC-1 (the certification standard for AI agents) and the California, Colorado, Texas and Washington AI rules.

value.label: Why AI Sentinel
value.v1.title: Full AI registry
value.v1.desc: Maintain a living inventory of every AI system, model, and agent across your organization, from draft through deployment to retirement.
value.v2.title: Guided risk classification
value.v2.desc: Apply the EU AI Act four-tier risk framework with a step-by-step Annex III wizard and maintain a full classification audit trail.
value.v3.title: Structured assessments
value.v3.desc: Run fundamental rights impact assessments, conformity assessments, AI risk evaluations and bias and fairness reviews with guided templates and approval workflows.
value.v4.title: Nine frameworks, one matrix
value.v4.desc: Map controls against the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and AIUC-1, the certification standard for AI agents, and five more: the GDPR and the California, Colorado, Texas and Washington AI rules. One answer evidences every framework it satisfies. Export compliance matrices for audits.
workflow.label: How it works
workflow.s1.title: Register your AI systems
workflow.s1.desc: Add every AI system, model, and data source to your living inventory with lifecycle tracking.
workflow.s2.title: Classify risk levels
workflow.s2.desc: Use the guided Annex III wizard to assign EU AI Act risk tiers with automatic scoring.
workflow.s3.title: Run impact assessments
workflow.s3.desc: Complete FRIAs, conformity checks, and bias evaluations using structured templates.
workflow.s4.title: Set up human oversight
workflow.s4.desc: Define approval gates at every stage: pre-deploy, post-deploy, periodic review, and incident-triggered.
workflow.s5.title: Track incidents & comply
workflow.s5.desc: Log AI incidents with severity assessment, response timelines, and Art. 73 notification workflows.
feat.label: Core Capabilities
feat.registry.title: AI Registry
feat.registry.headline: Know every AI system you operate.
feat.registry.desc: Maintain a living inventory of every AI system, model, and agent. Track lifecycle stages and assign roles under the EU AI Act.
feat.risk.title: Risk Classification
feat.risk.headline: Classify risk before you deploy.
feat.risk.desc: Apply the EU AI Act four-tier risk framework with a guided Annex III wizard and full classification history.
feat.oversight.title: Human Oversight
feat.oversight.headline: Humans in the loop, by design.

feat.incidents.headline: From detection to authority notification.

en.suite.label: What is included
en.suite.sub: One subscription covers all three: DPO Central, AI Sentinel and VendorWatch. You govern your AI in AI Sentinel, and add DPO Central and VendorWatch when you need them.
en.suite.dpc.name: DPO Central
en.suite.dpc.desc: Your privacy program, step by step, with a progress figure that rises only when you confirm.
en.suite.dpc.b1: The privacy laws that apply to you: the CCPA and CPRA, other US state laws and the GDPR
en.suite.dpc.b2: Guided assessments: DPIA, PIA, LIA and TIA
en.suite.ais.name: AI Sentinel
en.suite.ais.desc: The inventory of the AI systems you use or build, and the rules that apply to each.
en.suite.ais.b1: Register of AI systems and of unapproved AI tools
en.suite.ais.b2: Mapped to the EU AI Act, US state AI laws, the NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001
en.suite.ais.b4: Evidence for AI agents against AIUC-1
en.suite.vw.name: VendorWatch
en.suite.vw.desc: A catalog of vendors with their certifications, each linked to the vendor's own official page.
en.suite.vw.b2: Where each vendor keeps the data
en.suite.vw.b3: Direct import into your vendor list
en.suite.link.dpc: Each AI system, linked to its record in DPO Central
en.suite.link.vw: Vendors come from the VendorWatch catalog
en.videos.label: Videos
en.stages.label: How it works
en.stages.sub: AI Sentinel takes you through the stages of an AI governance program. Anything prepared automatically stays a draft until a person confirms it.
en.stages.s1.title: Set up
en.stages.s1.desc: Where you operate, and a few questions that decide which rules apply to you, such as the EU AI Act and the US state AI laws.
en.stages.s2.title: Policies and people
en.stages.s2.desc: The policy that says which AI tools may be used, and how.
en.stages.s3.title: Inventory
en.stages.s3.desc: Your AI systems and their owners, unapproved tools and vendors.
en.stages.s4.title: Classify and assess
en.stages.s4.desc: Each system's risk level, impact assessments and, if you use AI agents, their evidence against AIUC-1.
en.stages.s5.title: Controls and transparency
en.stages.s5.desc: Human oversight, the notice that AI is in use, and the evidence for each requirement.
en.stages.s6.title: Monitor and improve
en.stages.s6.desc: Incidents and their deadlines, the review of drafts and the report for leadership.
en.stages.plan.title: 30, 60 and 90-day plan
en.stages.plan.note: Day 1 is the day you complete the quick start.
en.ways.label: Guarantees and hosting
en.ways.sub: The same product, in five ways. You can start on the cloud and move later, and you can take your program with you at any time, as a file you download, including to a larger platform if you move to one.
en.ways.w1.title: TODO.LAW cloud
en.ways.w1.desc: You use it in the browser and we host it. A free pilot with limits, for test records rather than real client data.
en.ways.w2.title: The self-install kit
en.ways.w2.desc: Open source, installed with Docker on a machine you choose. You run it yourself, and the data stays with you.
en.ways.w3.title: TODO.LAW hardware
en.ways.w3.desc: Law-Firm-in-a-Box™: a quiet box in your office with everything pre-loaded, so your records stay on hardware you own.
en.ways.w3.subject: AI Sentinel on Law-Firm-in-a-Box
en.ways.w4.title: A managed instance
en.ways.w4.desc: An isolated instance for your organization alone, which we run for you.
en.ways.w4.subject: AI Sentinel: a managed instance
en.ways.w5.title: Deployment and training on your servers
en.ways.w5.desc: We set it up with you on your own servers, train your people and leave you a runbook.
en.ways.w5.subject: AI Sentinel: deployment and training on our servers
cta.text: AI Sentinel is a place to start your AI governance program, at a price a smaller team can afford, and it grows with you. The hosted service is a free, capped pilot. For real client data, run your own instance: managed by us or installed on your servers.
